s: How many legs does a dog have?
fakta: Dogs cool down by panting with their tongues out.

s: What colour is a ripe banana?
fakta: Bananas grow in big bunches that point up towards the sun.

s: What sound does a cow make?
fakta: A cow spends many hours a day chewing.

s: How many days are there in a week?
fakta: Saturday and Sunday make the weekend.

s: What do bees make?
fakta: Bees talk to each other by dancing.

s: Which animal says ‘baa’?
fakta: A baby sheep is called a lamb.

s: What colour is grass?
fakta: Grass grows from the bottom, so it keeps growing after it is cut.

s: How many wheels does a bicycle have?
fakta: A bike with three wheels is called a tricycle.

s: What do you call a baby dog?
fakta: Puppies are born with their eyes closed.

s: What do you call a baby cat?
fakta: Kittens open their eyes when they are about one week old.

s: Which animal has a very long trunk?
fakta: An elephant can use its trunk like a hand and a straw.

s: What is frozen water called?
fakta: Ice floats because it is lighter than water.

s: Which season comes after winter?
fakta: In spring, lambs are born and flowers come up.

s: How many months are there in a year?
fakta: The shortest month is February.

s: What colour do you get when you mix red and white?
fakta: Pink is also the colour of flamingos.

s: Which planet do we live on?
fakta: Most of the Earth is covered by sea.

s: What do we use to see?
fakta: Your eyes blink about 15 times a minute.

s: What do we breathe in to stay alive?
fakta: You breathe in and out more than 20,000 times a day.

s: Which animal is known for being slow and carrying a shell?
fakta: Some tortoises live for more than 100 years.

s: What shape has three sides?
fakta: A square has four sides that are all the same length.

s: How many sides does a square have?
fakta: All four corners of a square are right angles.

s: Which animal hops and lives in Australia?
fakta: Kangaroos cannot walk backwards.

s: What do you call a house for a dog?
fakta: Rabbits live in hutches and horses in stables.

s: Which bird cannot fly but is a great swimmer?
fakta: Penguins use their wings like flippers.

s: What do plants need to grow?
fakta: Plants make their own food from sunlight.

s: Which fruit is red and often eaten with cream at Wimbledon?
fakta: Strawberries have their seeds on the outside.

s: What colour is the sky on a sunny day?
fakta: Sunlight bounces around in the air, and the blue light spreads the most.

s: What do you call the person who drives a train?
fakta: A pilot flies a plane and a captain is in charge of a ship.

s: What do we call the meal we eat in the morning?
fakta: Breakfast means ‘breaking the fast’ after a night without food.

s: How many fingers are on one hand, counting the thumb?
fakta: Your thumb has two bones, and each of the other fingers has three.

s: Which animal lives in water and has fins?
fakta: Fish breathe with gills.

s: What is a baby frog called?
fakta: Tadpoles live in water and have tails.

s: What comes out of a volcano?
fakta: Lava is rock so hot that it has melted.

s: Who brings presents on Christmas Eve in Britain?
fakta: Children often leave out a mince pie for him and a carrot for the reindeer.

s: What does the Tooth Fairy leave when you lose a tooth?
fakta: Children put the tooth under their pillow.

s: What do you use to brush your teeth?
fakta: You should brush your teeth twice a day for two minutes.

s: Which number comes after 99?
fakta: 100 is called a hundred, and ten tens make 100.

s: What is 2 + 2?
fakta: Two pairs of shoes make four shoes.

s: What is 5 + 5?
fakta: You have ten fingers and ten toes.

s: What is the colour of a fire engine in Britain?
fakta: Fire engines have ladders, hoses and loud sirens.

s: Which animal is the biggest cat?
fakta: Tigers have stripes on their skin as well as on their fur.

s: What do you call a group of stars that makes a picture in the sky?
fakta: The Plough is a famous group of seven bright stars.

s: What do you put on a letter before you post it?
fakta: The first stamp, the Penny Black, was made in Britain in 1840.

s: Which animal gives us wool?
fakta: A sheep's wool is cut off once a year in summer.

s: What do hens lay?
fakta: A hen can lay almost one egg a day.

s: How many legs does a bird have?
fakta: Birds stand on two legs and use their wings to fly.

s: What is the opposite of ‘hot’?
fakta: Ice cream is cold and soup is hot.

s: What is the opposite of ‘up’?
fakta: Up and down, in and out, are opposites.

s: Which shape is round like a ball?
fakta: The Earth is almost a sphere.

s: Which fruit do monkeys love in cartoons?
fakta: Monkeys in the wild eat lots of fruit, leaves and insects.

s: What colour are most leaves in autumn before they fall?
fakta: The green colour fades and shows other colours underneath.

s: Which animal is famous for being black and white and living in China?
fakta: Pandas eat bamboo most of the day.

s: Which tool tells the time?
fakta: A ruler measures length and scales measure weight.

s: What do you call a baby horse?
fakta: Foals can stand up within an hour of being born.

s: What shines in the night sky and changes shape from full to half?
fakta: The Moon takes about a month to go through all its phases.

s: How many continents are there?
fakta: Asia is the largest continent.

s: What is the capital of the United Kingdom?
fakta: London is the largest city in the UK.

s: Which animal has a very long neck and brown patches?
fakta: A giraffe's tongue can be about 50 centimetres long.

s: What do we call the time when the Sun goes down in the evening?
fakta: The sky can turn red and orange at sunset.

s: Which clever sea animal often jumps out of the water?
fakta: Dolphins sleep with one half of their brain at a time.

s: How many hours are there in a day?
fakta: The Earth turns around once every day.

s: What do you call an animal that eats only plants?
fakta: Rabbits, cows and horses are herbivores.

s: What is the name of the bear who comes from Peru and loves marmalade?
fakta: Paddington wears a blue coat and a red hat.

s: In the story, what does the Very Hungry Caterpillar turn into?
fakta: The caterpillar eats lots of food before going to sleep in its cocoon.

s: Which fairy tale has three pigs and a big bad wolf?
fakta: The third little pig built his house out of bricks.

s: How many minutes are in an hour?
fakta: There are also 60 seconds in a minute.

s: What is 10 × 10?
fakta: Ten times ten is also called ten squared.

s: What is the name of the King's flag?
fakta: The Royal Standard flies when the King is at home.

s: Which very slow animal hangs upside down in trees?
fakta: Sloths only climb down from their trees about once a week.

s: Which animal is the national animal of Wales on its flag?
fakta: The red dragon of Wales is called Y Ddraig Goch.

s: Which day comes before Wednesday?
fakta: Wednesday is named after the old god Woden.

s: What are the colours of the Union Jack?
fakta: It is called the Union Flag too.

s: How many players are in a football team on the pitch?
fakta: One of them is the goalkeeper, who can use their hands.

s: What do we call a person who writes books?
fakta: An illustrator draws the pictures in a book.

s: Which bird hoots at night?
fakta: Owls have soft feathers so they can fly without a sound.

s: What gas do we need to breathe?
fakta: Trees and plants give out oxygen.

s: Which little insect is red with black spots?
fakta: Ladybirds eat greenfly, so gardeners love them.

s: What is the name of the line around the middle of the Earth?
fakta: It is hot all year round near the equator.

s: Which sense do we use with our nose?
fakta: We have five senses: sight, hearing, smell, taste and touch.

s: What do you call a baby duck?
fakta: Ducklings can swim soon after they hatch.
